Subject and separate object: SHOMI, the named Dropboarder from Zaun's local peer community. Dark brown skin, short tall textured magenta hair with closely cropped sides, round brass-rimmed protective goggles resting across the brow allowing natural brown eyes fully visible, broad playful but determined mouth, small plain brass earring. They wear a battered dark brown short coat over cream cloth and a simple ochre shoulder harness; one mechanical forearm visible low only if it fits. Not a different person, no hood, no blue glowing eyeglasses. Local industrial lane behind. Specialty object: one well-used compact single-person DROPBOARD, a broad dark purple wooden-and-metal oval deck with small copper fittings and three modest cyan inset glass circles, shown clearly alone at a slight diagonal on dark umber. This represents native adventure Logistics, not flying troops.
